description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model alias or full id. If not specified, the runner's default is used. codex (astra, sol, terra, luna, codex, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna; default sol -> gpt-6.1-sol); claude (fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, claude-fable-5-1, claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5; default fable -> claude-fable-5-1).

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra (supported levels vary by model). When omitted, no effort flag is passed and the CLI's own configuration applies.

run_in_background.description: Set to true to run this agent in the background. The tool result will include an output_file path - use Read tool or Bash tail to check on output.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of agentic turns (API round-trips) before stopping. Used internally for warmup.

resume.description: Optional agent ID to resume from. If provided, the agent will continue from the previous execution transcript.

$comment: Output schemas are documented in task_tool.output.schema.json
